svg.title: York Study
svg.desc: Interpretive study after an actually inspected primary reference. Geometry and interpretive screen colour approximate. Right-hand study: white asymmetrical rounded field against black rectangular painted support. White field meets the top, right and bottom edges as observed. Frame excluded; curvature is approximate. Foundation photograph explicitly labels this title and EK identifier; medium classification remains as sourced. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for black, white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://ellsworthkelly.org/exhibition/ellsworth-kelly-curated-by-jack-shear/; catalogue record foundation-exhib-v4-ek176-ellsworth-kelly-curated-by-jack-shear; inspected2026-10-27. Pure editable vector study, not photographic facsimile.
